court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, San Antonio
holding_summary: Partition/adverse-possession dispute among cotenant heirs over a 70-acre tract; no compensated occupancy of a dwelling is at issue.
notes: Cotenancy/adverse-possession case about farming and ranching a tract; no letting, lodging, or boarding of any kind.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Corpus Christi
holding_summary: Trademark ownership dispute over a corn tortilla brand, with a related lease of business equipment; no residential dwelling occupancy involved.
notes: The 'lease' at issue covers a corn-tortilla factory building/equipment for a commercial business, not a dwelling or rooms let for occupancy.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Amarillo
holding_summary: Third-party-beneficiary contract dispute over a medical scholarship agreement and a hospital clinic; no letting or occupancy of a dwelling is involved.
notes: Concerns scholarship-fund contract enforcement and hospital district damages; the word 'incidents of ownership' refers to a life-insurance policy, not real property letting.

court: Court of Appeals of Texas, Fort Worth
holding_summary: Commercial dispute over sale, storage, and conversion of diesel fuel oil under DTPA and contract theories; no residential letting is involved.
notes: Fuel-storage and sales contract litigation between corporations; unrelated to lodging, boarding, or dwelling occupancy.

court: Court of Appeals of Texas, Amarillo
holding_summary: Deed-restriction dispute over whether placing a mobile home for the owners' parents to live in part-time constitutes a prohibited 'construction' of a residence; no compensated letting to others.
notes: Family occupancy of a mobile home by the owners' own parents, not a paying lodger/boarder arrangement; case is about fixture/permanency doctrine under a restrictive covenant.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Fort Worth
holding_summary: Breach-of-contract suit over a hospital's obligation to honor a physician's office-space lease on hospital premises following a corporate stock/asset transfer; no residential dwelling occupancy.
notes: Concerns a commercial office lease for a psychiatrist's practice within a hospital building, not a residential letting or boarding arrangement.

court: Court of Appeals of Texas, Houston (14th Dist.)
holding_summary: Oil-and-gas royalty apportionment dispute governed by division and transfer orders; no dwelling occupancy or lodging is at issue.
notes: Purely a mineral-royalty payment dispute; the deed language about a 'lease' refers to oil and gas leasing, not residential letting.

court: Court of Appeals of Texas, Austin
holding_summary: Dispute over a city's revocable street-vending license for hot-dog stands, addressing license-vs-franchise doctrine; no residential dwelling or lodging involved.
notes: License/franchise distinction discussed here concerns street-vendor permits, not lodging-house or boarding-house licensing.

court: Court of Appeals of Texas, Tyler
holding_summary: Criminal appeal over the scope of a search warrant for an 'apartment,' which in passing quotes a definition distinguishing an apartment (exclusive control) from a rooming house.
notes: Defendant is the tenant/occupant of a leased apartment, not a person letting rooms to others; the apartment-vs-rooming-house definition is cited only to resolve Fourth Amendment search scope, not letting rights.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Fort Worth
holding_summary: Forcible-entry-and-detainer appeal addressing whether a county court retains jurisdiction to award back rent and attorney's fees after tenants vacate a commercial apartment pending appeal; procedural, not doctrinal.
notes: The underlying apartment lease is uncontested and mentioned only as background; the litigated issue is purely procedural jurisdiction over rent/attorney's-fee recovery, not the legal character of letting.

holding_summary: Upholds a municipal park-land-dedication ordinance as a valid police-power condition on subdivision plat approval; unrelated to lodging or boarding.
notes: Concerns subdivision development exactions for park land, not letting of dwellings or rooms.

court: Court of Appeals of Texas, Houston (1st Dist.)
holding_summary: Zoning-board appeal over changing a nonconforming commercial use from tavern to restaurant; no residential letting or boarding is at issue.
notes: Concerns nonconforming commercial-use zoning classification for a tavern/restaurant, unrelated to dwelling occupancy or lodging.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Waco
holding_summary: The court held that a residential landlord's oral month-to-month letting of an apartment carries no implied warranty of habitability or implied duty to repair absent an express agreement, applying the traditional caveat-emptor rule to leases in Texas.

quotes.text: The lease was oral and on a month-to-month basis.

The rule is well-settled in Texas that in the absence of fraud or deceit, there is no implied covenant that the demised premises are fit for occupation, or for the particular use which the tenant intends to make of them.
In the light of the foregoing authorities, we hold that the lease in the case at bar did not impose by implication a duty on the part of the landlord to make repairs to the leased premises.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Amarillo
holding_summary: Constitutional challenge to a municipal billboard/sign zoning and amortization ordinance; unrelated to residential letting or boarding.
notes: Concerns outdoor advertising regulation under the police power, not lodging or dwelling occupancy.

holding_summary: Upholds a municipal ordinance restricting mobile homes to designated mobile-home parks as a valid exercise of police power, based on sanitation, fire, and property-value concerns for owner-occupied residences.
notes: Regulates location of mobile homes intended as the owners' own residence, not letting of rooms/dwellings to paying occupants; mobile-home-park regulation is a related but distinct police-power topic from boarding-house licensing.

court: Court of Appeals of Texas, Houston (1st Dist.)
holding_summary: Restrictive-covenant enforcement action over a homeowner's conversion of an attached garage into living space; no letting or boarding at issue.
notes: Concerns a homeowner's own garage conversion under subdivision architectural restrictions, unrelated to compensated occupancy of dwellings by others.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, San Antonio
holding_summary: Royalty apportionment dispute under an oil, gas, and mineral lease and its pooling/ratification provisions; unrelated to residential letting.
notes: Concerns mineral lease royalty pooling and ratification, not letting of a dwelling or rooms.

court: Court of Appeals of Texas, Houston (14th Dist.)
holding_summary: Restrictive-covenant suit over commercial (car-wash) use of a residential lot, resolved on limitations and waiver grounds; unrelated to residential letting or boarding.
notes: Concerns commercial-use covenant violation (real estate office, then car wash), not lodging, boarding, or short-term letting of a dwelling.
